vape: Carry-on only. Not allowed in checked baggage. Must be switched off during the flight and cannot be charged on board.
e-cigarette: Carry-on only. Not allowed in checked baggage. Keep switched off during the flight.
lithium battery: Carry-on only. Under 100Wh is fine. Between 100 and 160Wh requires airline approval. Over 160Wh is not permitted.
power bank: Carry-on only. Under 100Wh is fine, 100-160Wh needs airline approval. Not allowed in checked baggage.
spare battery: Carry-on only. Tape over the terminals. Not allowed in checked baggage.
knife: Checked baggage only. Blades over 6cm are not allowed in the cabin, including penknives.
scissors: Allowed in carry-on if the blade is under 6cm from the pivot. Otherwise pack in checked baggage.
lighter: One lighter on your person only. Not allowed in any bag, hand luggage or hold.
matches: One book of safety matches on your person only. Not allowed in checked baggage.
liquid: Carry-on: 100ml maximum per item, all in a single 1-litre clear bag. No limit in checked baggage.
shampoo: Under 100ml is fine in carry-on. Larger sizes must go in checked baggage.
perfume: Under 100ml in carry-on. Up to 500ml total per person across hold and cabin.
deodorant: Solid deodorant is fine in carry-on. Spray under 100ml in carry-on or pack in checked baggage.
baby formula: Allowed in carry-on, including over 100ml if you're travelling with the baby. Declare at security.
baby food: Allowed in carry-on, including over 100ml if you're travelling with the baby.
medication: Allowed in carry-on. Bring your prescription. Liquid medication over 100ml is allowed with documentation.
insulin: Allowed in carry-on. Needles permitted with a doctor's letter. Keep refrigerated where possible.
food: Solid food is fine in carry-on. Liquids and gels still follow the 100ml rule.
alcohol: Up to 70% ABV. Checked baggage: 5 litres maximum if 24-70% ABV. Carry-on follows the 100ml rule (duty-free has its own process).
snow globe: Allowed in carry-on only if the visible water is under 100ml. Otherwise pack in checked baggage.
tools: Tools longer than 6cm must go in checked baggage. This includes screwdrivers, drills, and similar.
drone: Carry-on only. Lithium battery rules apply. Some destinations restrict drones, so check before you fly.
laptop: Allowed in carry-on. On older scanners you'll need to remove it. New CT scanners (in some Heathrow lanes) let you leave it in your bag.
tablet: Allowed in carry-on. Same scanner rule as laptops.
camera: Allowed in carry-on. Spare batteries must stay in carry-on.
hair straightener: Allowed in carry-on. Cordless models: remove the battery. Mains-powered models are fine.
curling iron: Same rules as hair straighteners. Gas-powered ones are carry-on only, one per person.
umbrella: Allowed in carry-on. Folding umbrellas preferred.
musical instrument: Allowed in carry-on if it fits in the overhead locker. Larger instruments need an extra seat or checked baggage.
guitar: Carry-on (overhead or extra seat) or checked baggage in a hard case.
electric scooter: Lithium battery rules apply. Often prohibited; check with the airline before you travel.
fireworks: Prohibited in both carry-on and checked baggage.
gas canister: Prohibited. This includes camping gas and similar canisters.
pepper spray: Prohibited in both carry-on and checked baggage.
taser: Prohibited. Self-defence weapons are not allowed.
razor: Disposable razors are fine in carry-on. Safety razors are allowed without the blade. Cut-throat razors must go in checked baggage.
nail file: Allowed in carry-on if metal and under 6cm.
needle: Allowed in carry-on, including knitting needles.
syringe: Allowed in carry-on with a medical letter.
gun: Only allowed if pre-declared, in a locked case, in checked baggage. Permits required.
ammunition: Checked baggage only. Up to 5kg per person. Must be locked and declared.
replica gun: Prohibited in both carry-on and checked baggage by most airlines.
toy gun: Allowed in carry-on if obviously a toy. Checked baggage is safer.
candle: Allowed in carry-on and checked baggage.
oil paint: Checked baggage only. Quantity limits apply because it's flammable.
pesticide: Prohibited in both carry-on and checked baggage. Toxic.
mercury thermometer: Prohibited. Mercury is a hazardous material.
dry ice: Carry-on: up to 2.5kg in vented packaging. Checked baggage: also up to 2.5kg.
frozen food: Allowed in checked baggage. If using dry ice for cooling, the dry ice rules apply.
helium balloon: Prohibited. Pressurised gas is not allowed.
magnet industrial: Checked baggage only. Strength limits apply.
fuel cell: Prohibited unless under specific airline approval.
battery dry: Allowed in carry-on. Tape the terminals.
oxygen cylinder: Prohibited unless medically required, declared in advance, and in checked baggage.
paragliding: Checked baggage only. Must not contain fuel.
bow arrow: Checked baggage only, in a locked case.
surfboard: Checked baggage only. Length-based fees may apply.
ski: Checked baggage only. Length-based fees may apply.
